ValidationRule.description: Do not allow to update the case after 7days of closure
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Profile.Name = "System Administrator"), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "SSV_CustomerSupportEmergencyAfterHours", RecordType.DeveloperName = "SSV_CustomerSupport" ), OR( TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Status)) = "Closed", TEXT(Status) = "Closed" ), SSV_7DaysFromClose__c <= TODAY() )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Case cannot be updated after 7 days of closure.
